meta.description: Python/HTSlib workflows for genomic files. Use when reading, querying, filtering, or writing SAM/BAM/CRAM, VCF/BCF, FASTA/FASTQ, or tabix data with pysam, including pileup, coverage, indexing, and CRAM references. Provides comprehensive coordinate contract documentation and bundled audit scripts.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated data claims; accurate representation of pysam/HTSlib capabilities

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for bioinformatics file I/O; clear warnings about coordinate systems and format requirements

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established genomic file format standards (SAM/BAM/CRAM, VCF/BCF); proper coordinate semantics

code_usability.detail: All 4 bundled scripts are syntactically correct with proper error handling

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of HTSlib-supported formats with alignment, variant, sequence, and tabix workflows

reliability.note: Excellent reliability with documented common failure modes, explicit error handling patterns, and validation guidance

performance_context.note: Well-organized with 9 comprehensive reference files, clear bundled scripts table, performance guidance for threads and CRAM

agent_usability.note: Outstanding with explicit coordinate contract (0-based vs 1-based), First Decide checklist, reference map, and 11-item common failure modes list

human_usability.note: Clear installation with pinned pysam 0.24.0, all scripts have --help, usage examples throughout

security.note: Excellent security posture: local-only file operations, no network calls, bundled scripts refuse to overwrite, proper argument handling

maintainability.note: Version 2.0, MIT license, migration guide from 0.14, upstream baseline clearly stated (pysam 0.24.0 / HTSlib 1.23.1)

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with allowed-tools, clear trigger (genomic file formats), progressive disclosure via reference map; minor: bundled scripts lack inline usage examples

recommendations.title: Add inline usage examples to bundled scripts
recommendations.problem: Scripts rely on --help but lack embedded examples for common patterns
recommendations.root_cause: Agent-specific criterion 'Progressive Disclosure' not fully met
recommendations.fix: Add 2-3 example invocations as comments at top of each script, e.g., '# Example: python inspect_hts.py sample.bam --reference ref.fa'

recommendations.title: Document pileup default behaviors more prominently
recommendations.problem: Pileup defaults (base quality 13, depth 8000) are documented but easy to miss
recommendations.root_cause: Common failure mode listed but not emphasized in main pileup section
recommendations.fix: Add explicit note in ## Alignment Files pileup code block: '# IMPORTANT: pileup() defaults to base quality 13 and max_depth 8000'

recommendations.title: Add pointer to RNA-seq quantification tools
recommendations.problem: Scope boundary input (RNA-seq expression) lacks redirect to appropriate tools
recommendations.root_cause: Reference map does not include 'what this skill does NOT do' section
recommendations.fix: Add 'Out of Scope' section noting: 'For transcript/gene quantification, use HTSeq, featureCounts, Salmon, or kallisto'
